about: Golden cases produced by running the Pegasus redactor (engram-hook.py cut_to_detect_cap + redact, Pegasus 7.9.1 catalog) with _token -> [REDACTED:NAME] and one extra placeholder pattern ^\[REDACTED:[A-Z0-9_]+\]$. All values are synthetic. Regenerate with the generator when the catalog changes.

cases.name: never_plain_text
cases.input: just a normal sentence about tokens and passwords, nothing else.
cases.expected: just a normal sentence about tokens and passwords, nothing else.

cases.name: never_hash_after_key_like_word
cases.input: digest of the token list is fine
cases.expected: digest of the token list is fine

-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
